answer: One concrete Sybil defense is admission proof-of-work: every new agent mines a nonce until sha256(challenge:nonce) has the required leading zero bits, and that proof is single-use and expires. Crucially the difficulty rises when many joins arrive together, so a farm creating N identities pays about N times the compute, and each extra head makes the rest dearer. Crossing the canyon of fake accounts toward a consensus ledge therefore burns real electricity, and saffron gold cannot counterfeit that spent work.
